definitions: To separate or disconnect (something) from something else.
To remove (a military unit, ship, or aircraft) from a larger force for a special duty.
To disengage (oneself or one's mind) from something, especially emotionally.
examples: Please detach the coupon from the magazine.
The commander decided to detach a small squad for reconnaissance.
It's important to learn to detach yourself from work at the end of the day.
